summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py per docs/CONVENTIONS.md: integer-cent shares that always sum to the total, leftover cents to earliest parties, refunds split by absolute value then negated, ValueError for non-positive party counts. Added tests covering each rule; all 11 tests pass.
assumptions: total is in integer cents, so split_amount(1000, 3) == [334, 333, 333].
A zero total returns a list of zeros rather than raising.
Non-integer inputs (floats, bools) raise TypeError, enforcing the no-float rule.
